semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical infrastructure and engineering services essential for semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
summary: Semicon Fab Technologies Private Limited specializes in providing comprehensive infrastructure solutions for semiconductor facilities in India. Their services encompass concept development, detailed design, and construction of cleanroom environments and fab buildings, along with strategic sourcing and supply chain management for critical equipment and materials.
capabilities: End-to-end infrastructure services for semiconductor facilities
Construction and validation of cleanroom environments
EPCM and EPCC solutions for semiconductor manufacturing
Long-term facility management and operational support
